meta.title: Swedish Yellow Hussars
meta.note: Original reconstruction after Schützercrantz. Synthetic adult: stature 178 cm, chest 100 cm, waist 86 cm, head 58 cm. Make a toile. Print at 100%.

pieces.name: Breeches front
pieces.note: Close centre front. Staystitch and face each marked 172 mm fall slit. Leave outer knee vents open.

pieces.name: Breeches back
pieces.note: Cut mirror pair. Seat curve rises at centre back. Check seated depth in a toile.

pieces.name: Breeches waistband
pieces.note: Fold along centre. Leave both 102 mm centre-front sections independent behind the fall. Button the 32 mm extension.

pieces.name: Breeches fall facing
pieces.note: Face the integral drop front; stitch at the waist and along both slit edges. Turn and button to the band.

pieces.name: Fall opening stay
pieces.note: Stay each marked slit. Clip to the lower end and turn; reinforce the corner.

pieces.name: Breeches knee band
pieces.note: Fold lengthwise. Match the 171 mm front and 193 mm back; leave 25 mm for the button overlap.

pieces.name: Breeches knee vent underlap
pieces.note: Apply to the back edge of the 66 mm knee vent. Finish the opposite vent edge.

pieces.name: Charivades front
pieces.note: Face scallops with regimental binding. Leave outer seam below knee open for buttons.

pieces.name: Charivades back
pieces.note: Face scallops with regimental binding. Leave outer seam below knee open for buttons.

pieces.name: Charivades button stand
pieces.note: Join the divided edge to the back opening, matching the calf station. Fold and set buttons opposite the front.

pieces.name: Dolman centre back
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Dolman front
pieces.note: Cut mirrored in shell and lining. Transfer the twelve cord paths before assembly; button the fastening front.

pieces.name: Dolman side back
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Dolman upper sleeve
pieces.note: Ease the cap into the armscye. Match front, side-back and shoulder marks.

pieces.name: Dolman under sleeve
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Dolman pointed cuff
pieces.note: Cut a pair plus facing. Close short ends; apply at wrist.

pieces.name: Dolman stand collar
pieces.note: Cut one outer and one undercollar. Match shoulders and centre back before setting the stand.

pieces.name: Dolman front facing
pieces.note: Cut a pair. Sew at the front opening, turn and secure to lining.

pieces.name: Pelisse centre back
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Pelisse front
pieces.note: Cut mirrored in shell and lining. Transfer the twelve cord paths before assembly; button the fastening front.

pieces.name: Pelisse side back
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Pelisse upper sleeve
pieces.note: Ease the cap into the armscye. Match front, side-back and shoulder marks.

pieces.name: Pelisse under sleeve
pieces.note: Cut a mirrored pair in outer cloth and a pair in lining.

pieces.name: Pelisse pointed cuff
pieces.note: Cut a pair plus facing. Close short ends; apply at wrist.

pieces.name: Pelisse stand collar
pieces.note: Cut one outer and one undercollar. Match shoulders and centre back before setting the stand.

pieces.name: Pelisse front facing
pieces.note: Cut a pair. Sew at the front opening, turn and secure to lining.

pieces.name: Pelisse fur opening strip
pieces.note: Place over the finished opening. Tack flat with nap toward hem. Meet hem trim at lower corners.

pieces.name: Pelisse fur hem half
pieces.note: Join halves at centre back. Turn to fur side.

pieces.name: Busby - lower wall
pieces.note: Join centre-back edges. The 590 mm base allows 10 mm over a 580 mm head.

pieces.name: Busby - upper wall
pieces.note: Match the four lower quarters to the lower wall; align both back seams.

pieces.name: Busby - crown tip
pieces.note: Match quarter marks; align long axis front to back. Ease evenly around the turn.

pieces.name: Hat - inside sweatband
pieces.note: Join short ends. Match lower quarters to the hat base, turn inward and tack.

pieces.name: Busby - pendant bag
pieces.note: Sew mirrored sides and point. Turn, tuck the mouth inward and tack under the upper band.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - palm
pieces.note: Stretch across the palm. Use fine 1.5 mm glove seams; clip carefully to the marked webs.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - back
pieces.note: Pair one back with the opposite-facing palm from the same hand. Use the named finger edges.

pieces.name: Finger web - little / ring
pieces.note: Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.

pieces.name: Finger web - ring / middle
pieces.note: Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.

pieces.name: Finger web - middle / index
pieces.note: Widest point at the finger web. Taper each end into its named fingertip.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - thumb socket gusset
pieces.note: Close the short ends. Set the 86 mm lower ring into the two thumb openings. Place the tall point toward the thumb web.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - thumb palm
pieces.note: Set the root to the palm half of the thumb gusset. Close both thumb faces around the tip.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - thumb back
pieces.note: Set this root to the back half of the thumb gusset.

pieces.name: Gauntlet - flared cuff
pieces.note: Close cuff seam; match the 101 mm wrist halves to the palm and back. Bind the 292 mm flared opening.

pieces.name: Neck stock - face
pieces.note: Sew lining at both long edges; turn and finish ends. Fit tabs at the marked positions for a 39-43 cm neck.

pieces.name: Neck stock - lining
pieces.note: Sew lining at both long edges; turn and finish ends. Fit tabs at the marked positions for a 39-43 cm neck.

pieces.name: Barrel sash - cord foundation
pieces.note: Couch twelve cord rows; bind them in eighteen marked barrel groups. Work this face before adding the backing.

pieces.name: Barrel sash - backing
pieces.note: Join both long edges to the corded face; turn, finish the ends and add the ties over the dolman.

pieces.name: Barrel sash - ties
pieces.note: Fold lengthwise, sew the long edges and turn. Secure one tie to each end of the sash. Add a cord tassel.

pieces.name: Costume crossbelt - broad
pieces.note: Butt-stitch the shoulder ends. Fit the hip overlap and secure with costume snaps. Finish the long edges.

pieces.name: Costume crossbelt - narrow
pieces.note: Butt-stitch the shoulder ends. Fit the hip overlap and secure with costume snaps. Finish the long edges.
